description: GET /dashboard (§4.7 D1, in part; DEC-2413): the workspace's agents as GET /agents lists them, and each account the control stream names (ConnectionRequested or ConnectionEstablished) with its latest AccountSnapshotRecorded, the broker's account as reconciliation journals it. as_of names the control stream and each agent and account stream read that holds a row.

Account.description: One account stream, in the order the control stream first names it.

snapshot.description: The latest AccountSnapshotRecorded on the stream, whatever its version (journal spec §9.35); null while the stream holds none.

Snapshot.description: The broker's figures as the snapshot records them (journal spec §9.2, §9.35), never derived or rounded. last_equity and day_change are null for a version 1 snapshot, which carries no prior close: never zero and never equity.

last_equity.description: The broker's equity at the prior session's close (trading spec §7.2), from a version 2 snapshot.

day_change.description: equity − last_equity, signed; null when last_equity is.
